title.narrative: Twinning Contract: Strengthening the capacity of Jordan's Department of Statistics in terms of compilation, analysis and reporting of statistical data in line with International and European best practices

description.narrative: To strengthen the capacity of Jordans Department of Statistics (DoS) in terms of compilation, analysis and reporting of statistical data in line with International and European best practices, through the development of business and population statistics, and enhancement of DoSs statistical outputs via adopting new policy-oriented statistics, and updating methodologies particularly for survey-based data.
